name: seq_page_cost
description: Planner's estimate of the cost of a sequentially fetched disk page relative to cpu_operator_cost.
symptoms: Suboptimal query plans (e.g., choosing seq scan over index scan unnecessarily)
Excessive disk I/O due to missed index usage
tuning_tips: Increase seq_page_cost on fast storage (e.g., NVMe) to discourage unnecessary sequential scans; decrease it on slow storage or when RAM is abundant and OS cache is effective. Tune in tandem with random_page_cost to reflect actual I/O latency ratios.
default_formula: 1.0 (baseline); adjust relative to random_page_cost based on storage latency ratio (e.g., random_page_cost / seq_page_cost ≈ 4 for HDD, ≈ 1.1–1.5 for SSD)
